Hamilton · ref. H38429730

Intra-Matic Auto Chrono

Chronograph · 40–42mm · 100m · manual-wind

The Intra-Matic Auto Chrono family is a modern reinterpretation of Hamilton's classic chronographs from the 1960s. It is defined by its vintage-inspired design, often featuring bi-compax 'panda' or 'reverse panda' dials, and is available in both automatic and manual-winding versions.

The story

The modern Intra-Matic Auto Chrono is a tribute to a 1968 signature piece, launched during the pivotal era of the race to create the first automatic chronograph movement. The contemporary revival began in 2017 with the 42mm limited edition 'Intra-Matic 68'. Following its success, a regular production model was introduced in 2018 with a more vintage-appropriate 40mm case size. In 2021, the family expanded to include the 'Chronograph H' line, which brought back a hand-wound movement, further strengthening the connection to its historical predecessors.
